<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQz5ads6H8aCEFkS1FIS"> <mxGraphModel dx="1589" dy="872" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Entry and Input
 User([Candidate PDF Upload]) -->|Selects resume.pdf| FE[React / Next.js Client SPA]
 FE -->|POST /api/resume/upload| Gateway[Next.js API Server]
 Gateway -->|Forwards multipart/form-data| PythonBackend[FastAPI Python Server: api.py]

 %% PDF Extraction
 subgraph ParserEngine [Python Parser & Text Processing]
 PythonBackend -->|Initiate| ResumeParser[ResumeParser Utility]
 ResumeParser -->|Extract plain text| TextExtractor[PDF Text Extractor]
 TextExtractor -->|Clean tokens & whitespace| TextClean[Structured Plain Text]
 end

 %% Ollama Generation Tasks
 TextClean -->|Inject into Prompts| OllamaRouter{Ollama local:11434 Engine}
 
 subgraph OllamaTasks [Ollama gemma3:4b Core Processing]
 %% ATS Score
 OllamaRouter -->|Prompt 1: Calculate Score| TaskATS[ATS Scoring Module]
 TaskATS -->|Rules: Keywords & formatting| OllamaATS[Compute scores: Tech, Layout, Impact]
 
 %% Claim Verification QGen
 OllamaRouter -->|Prompt 2: Verify Claims| TaskQGen[Claim Question Generation]
 TaskQGen -->|Rules: Extract projects & claims| OllamaQGen[Form questions & expected keywords]
 
 %% Feedback / Optimization
 OllamaRouter -->|Prompt 3: Optimize Resume| TaskFB[Feedback & Optimization suggestions]
 TaskFB -->|Rules: Strengths & Weaknesses| OllamaFB[Actionable bullet suggestions]
 end

 %% Aggregation and Verification
 OllamaATS --> Aggregator[Output Combiner]
 OllamaQGen --> Aggregator
 OllamaFB --> Aggregator

 subgraph SchemaValidation [JSON Schema Validation & Fallback]
 Aggregator --> ParseValidation{Is output parseable JSON?}
 ParseValidation -->|No| AttemptRepair[Apply local regex/JSON fixer]
 AttemptRepair --> RepairCheck{Repair working?}
 RepairCheck -->|No| GeminiFallback[Fallback: Query Google Gemini Cloud API]
 RepairCheck -->|Yes| ValidJSON[Merged JSON Payload]
 ParseValidation -->|Yes| ValidJSON
 GeminiFallback --> ValidJSON
 end

 %% DB and Rendering
 ValidJSON --> SaveToFirestore[(Save Analysis to Firestore 'users_interviews')]
 ValidJSON --> ResponseToClient[Send 200 OK Response]
 ResponseToClient --> RenderDashboard[Render Dashboard: Score Gauge, Suggestions & Question Bank]",
 "config": null
